summary: Revised TuckBook Implementation Plan incorporating the Final UI Cleanup & Reference Design Audit (matching school-store-flow.lovable.app). Streamlines navigation into 5 dedicated tabs (Home, Sell, Products, Book, More), clarifies the dashboard with uncluttered cards, removes automatic demo seed on first launch (empty catalogue by default with optional demo preset in Settings), while strictly preserving all backend security, offline Room persistence, Gemini AI advisor, Google Drive backups, and high-load stability.
